pages.text: It was picnic day. Grandma Bear packed a piece of cheese for each friend.
Rudi hugged their cheese. "This is mine."
The five sat in a circle on the grass. Ppino cut their cheese in half.
Ppino gave half to Soso. Soso gave half their bread in return.
The four traded little pieces with each other. Rudi turned away to eat.
Rudi finished the cheese. Everyone else was still eating.
Nothing remained in front of Rudi. The other four still had many things to eat.
Grandma Bear sat beside Rudi. "Eat alone, and you have just one thing."
At the next picnic, Rudi cut their cheese in half.
As the four passed, each left a little something. Cheese, bread, and apples piled up in front of Rudi.
